Sent: 2/27/2024 3:26 PM
Subject: Aurora Investments

Pinnacle Investments has gotten back to me and is vacillating on what they want to do with the Excelsior trades.  In particular, they haven't thought through what they want to do with the online trades, don't like online documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the trades once they decide how to resolve this.  So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Oakwood Asset Management financial trades and master sit.
